items.text: Hey Jotunnslayers!
Patch 1.2.4 is here! This update brings fixes for Objectives, co-op and environment collisions, along with a fix for the passive skill interaction reported in our previous update.
Thanks for sharing your reports on Discord and the community hub. Your feedback helps us keep improving the journey through Hel!
Objectives: Fixed issues where Objectives would not appear or be offered.
Loading: Fixed issues caused by alt-tabbing during loading screens.
Co-op: Fixed an issue where HP values were not visible.
Co-op: Fixed issues with reviving players.
Environment: Fixed various collision issues.
Blasphemy: Reroll is no longer available when selecting a God for Blasphemy.
Various other fixes.
Skill Shop: Fixed the interaction between Qualified Experience and Quickness. Both passives now work correctly together.
Keep the feedback coming, and get back out there and show Hel what you’re made of!
Hey Jotunnslayers!

[p align="start"]We’re back with Hotfix 1.2.3! Following up on our recent updates, the team has been focused on smoothing out the cooperative experience and addressing some specific platform stability issues.

[p align="start"]As always, your reports in Discord and the community hub are our best weapon for tracking down these edge cases. Thank you for your continued support and patience as we polish the path through Hel.
Gameplay Fixes
Local Co-op: Fixed a bug where the Archmage could not correctly choose all 4 sub-classes when playing as the second player in local co-op.
Local Co-op: The revive popup will no longer erroneously appear for both players if they are defeated at the exact same time.
Keybinds: Fixed various issues occurring when resetting keybinds to their default settings.
Environment: Improved colliders across Stygia to prevent snagging and ensure a smoother movement experience.

We are aware of an issue where Fate’s temporary experience bonus (Qualified Experience) does not function correctly if the player has purchased Loki’s Quickness permanent passive. We are currently working on a fix for this interaction.
[p align="start"]
We are still monitoring your feedback closely, so please keep those reports coming. Now, get back out there and show Hel what you're made of!
Hey Jotunnslayers!
We’re back with Hotfix 1.2.2! Following up on last week's update, the team has been working hard to address the remaining issues you’ve flagged.
Your reports in Discord and the forums continue to be our best weapon against these bugs. Thank you for your patience as we continue to refine the experience.
Fixed a bug preventing the Triumphant Aspis trophy from unlocking for eligible players.
Tomb doors in Stygia now visually open and close correctly according to their state.
Fixed a bug causing the game to freeze for some players immediately after summoning the boss in Stygia.
Level-up rewards will now correctly apply even if the game window loses focus during the selection process.
Improved player and enemy collision across multiple maps for a smoother experience.
We are still monitoring your feedback closely, so please keep those reports coming. Now, get back out there and show Hel what you're made of.
Hey Jotunnslayers!
We are rolling out Hotfix 1.2.1 today to squash a few bugs and smooth out your experience, particularly for those of you diving into the recent Conan DLC.
Thank you to everyone who has been reporting these bugs on the forums and in Discord. Your feedback helps us pinpoint these issues quickly so we can keep improving the game.
Fixed an issue where Stygia objectives would occasionally fail to spawn in certain scenarios.
Resolved a bug that prevented Trophy progress from being counted correctly.
Conan swords will now correctly require the appropriate resources to unlock as intended.
Summoning a boss in the very last second of a timer will no longer cause gameplay issues or hangs.
Keybinding changes will now correctly apply to both players in co-op mode.
Ongoing Investigations

We want to give a quick heads-up that we are actively investigating reports regarding save issues, as well as the Stygia boss fight not functioning properly for some players. We are working hard to get these resolved as soon as possible, and we appreciate your patience while we dig into them.
As always, thank you for the incredible support. Now, back to the slaying!

releases.displayName: Conan breaks into Hel - New DLC and Local Co-op update revealed (DEVBLOG 17)

notes.title: Together with our friends from Heroic Signatures, we’ve forged a brutal crossover where two savage worlds collide.

items.text: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4369830/Jotunnslayer_Hordes_of_Hel__Conan/"]

Hither came Conan, the Cimmerian, black-haired, sullen-eyed, sword in hand, a thief, a reaver, a slayer, with gigantic melancholies and gigantic mirth, to tread the jeweled thrones of the Earth under his sandalled feet.
Conan brings a combat style built around momentum, aggression, and battlefield dominance. His core mechanic - Triumph - rewards active combat and elite hunting.
Triumph - defeating enemies can grant Triumph stacks, each blocking one instance of incoming damage
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/b336d1378835c8d1a30e001b7da08f54db3664e7.gif"]
Born in Battle - elevated critical hit chance and critical damage from the start
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/0f53da0ce26f4323d121b3810c52041c4a2a19ef.gif"]
Ram Dash - a forward charge that damages enemies along its path
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/d00f894cb43324ba41fc01ef43aef132994a1fa4.gif"]

notes.title: Conan Subclasses - Three paths of Legend

items.text: Each subclass reshapes how Triumph behaves and how Conan controls the battlefield.
King of Aquilonia
A heavy greatsword ruler focused on devastating cleaves and elite execution. Fewer Triumph interactions - more raw power and longer, more punishing dashes.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/3963d4257c5ae4eeb9a350debe3c386f71a77469.gif"]

notes.title: Slow, but hard-hitting greatsword at hand dealing damage at the end of Dash.

items.text: Stygian Gladiator Sword-and-shield pitfighter built for control and durability. Higher Triumph capacity, stun potential, and defensive scaling per stack.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/c2cb5195b704d9028fc05f73eedb193ee36ad6c9.gif"]

notes.title: Master of arms that prefers sword-and-board with an extra stunning Shield Attack.

items.text: Zamorian Rogue A fast dual-wielding raider who converts Triumph into mobility and evasion. Lower stack limits, but each stack fuels dash charges and survivability through movement.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/86c998b5edac7600edb15f00e122f4e6cb65bed4.gif"]

illusion-driven threats and ambush-style enemy encounters
undead and necromantic forces guarding ancient secrets
relic-rich ruins that reward bold exploration

Stygia is less about comfort and more about survival under pressure - every run should feel tense, dangerous, and unpredictable.

items.text: Fate introduces a risk-and-reward blessing system built around symbolic draws and scaling outcomes. Each time you invest, you generate symbols that determine which tier of reward you can claim - from modest boosts to run-defining power spikes.
stacking XP bonuses
magnet and resource boosts
multi-level jumps
massive gold and soulstone bursts
conditional drop-rate surges
But Fate is not generous by default - weak rolls are possible, and greedy plays can backfire. This god is for players who enjoy pushing their luck and adapting on the fly.

items.text: Hey Jotunnslayers!
We’re excited to roll out Patch 1.0.1!

This patch focuses on balance updates, bug fixes, and quality of life improvements inspired directly by your feedback. Thanks so much for playing, sharing your thoughts, and helping us make the game better every step of the way.
General Progression
Increased XP gain by ~30%.
Reduced enemy difficulty both between locations and across location difficulties.
Max cost capped at 50 Gold.
Early costs unchanged, but progression is now less punishing mid- and late-game.
Endless Mode
Increased base time between torments from 80s → 180s to make gameplay more relaxing.
Trophy requirement adjusted: now requires reaching Torment Tier V (was Tier VII).
Helheim
Chamber 3 enemy compositions rebalanced.
Crawlers: reduced movement speed and lowered health.
Hounds: added a maximum spawn cap.
Kinslayer Class Rework
Base Trait: +50% Attack Damage.
Shadow Archon: +15% movement speed, heals for 3 HP when applying Curse. Re-focused on lifesteal builds.
Warglaive: Attack Speed increased from +10% to +25%; Evasion increased from +12% to +15%. Stronger attack-focused option.
Restless Spirit: Class & God Damage bonus +20%; Max Health penalty changed to Damage Reduction –15%. Gains stackable damage bonus on revive, but takes more damage each time.
Objectives
Wind Crystal damage drastically reduced (from ~150 → ~50) to prevent one-shot kills.
Demolition Site objective damage reduced.
Endless trophies for Muspelheim and Jotunheim can now be unlocked in non-Endless difficulties (friendlier for new players).
Encyclopedia Screen: icons updated, text centered, and fixed display of DLC weapon skills.
Displays one empty row if no curses.
Adds an empty row only when the last row is full.
Fixed overlapping text in French.
Fixed weapon skill icon auto-selection.
Stats/Attributes cleanup and button adjustments.
Fixed hints and navigation issues.
Skill shop (gods/classes).
Rerolling gods after blind choice.
Reward selection window missing text.
Result screen popup.
Main menu order (Discord button now correctly before Feedback).
Navigation between Difficulty and Modifiers tabs.
Keyboard and mouse hints for objectives, torment, and reward selection.
Corrected D-pad → Right Stick hint in Options.
Disabled gamepad hints for scrollbars.
Fixed overlapping texts for Gold and Mithril Ore in some languages.
Fixed missing subtitles during Muspelheim boss fight.
Fixed trophy hall mouse scrolling.
Fixed crash/freeze when opening double chest level up.
Fixed banish system bugs.
Fixed lifesteal: now works properly even at low attack damage, with correct stats display.
Removed 0% value entries in stats screen (e.g. Ranger’s Wild Hearth passive without wolf active).
Fixed Torment timer freezing at zero when reviving.
Fixed Quiver of Ullr trophy unlock issue.
Fixed Pack Tactics not unlocking under correct conditions.
Fixed health bars staying in the air after death.
Fixed incorrect Endless objective rewards.
Fixed nithstangs in Helheim being invisible in Endless mode.
Fixed missing hints during boss cutscenes.
Fixed icons darkening incorrectly when banish option was declined.

Hey Jotunnslayers!
Welcome to Dev Blog #13 for Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel! The next update is bringing an entirely new world - Jotunheim - along with the arrival of a powerful new god, Skadi!

In today’s blog, we’ll dive into the lore, game design, and visual aesthetics of Jotunheim’s harsh and unforgiving landscapes. We’ll also explore what Skadi brings to the battlefield and highlight additional improvements and fixes coming with this update.
Alright, let's go!
HOW DOES THE JOTUNHEIM LOOK AND FEEL?

While trying to maintain familiarity with what the old Norse could have described as an alien giant-occupied landscape, we have imagined a cold, harsh, and barely hospitable tundra in the mountainous plateaus of Jotunheim. The realm's environment should be, after all, the reason for the Jotnar savagery and brutality.

We have settled primarily around large basalt column structures, resembling a sort of purposeful giant-cut architecture. The uninviting, yet strangely cozy ambiance of stone-cold rock is underlined by volcanic sands, dry grass, and bone-to-leather props - all to create an eerily primal image.

With the props being the main visual cues to reinforce the environment's theme, we have decided to amp up the ante of the map itself and introduce environmental hazards in the form of strong winds and magical basalt bridges that will connect individual plateaus.
At the end of it all, Jotunheim should seem vivid and northerly exotic while feeling harsh and forbidding.
NEW ENEMIES

Creatures and monsters you encounter in Jotunheim fit right into this fragmented yet primordial landscape. However, with a slight twist: in Jotunheim, everything might end up giant: giants among giants, staggering elementals, gargantuan insects - or the worst nightmare of all - enormous flying bugs!

Yes, aside from the massive ancient civilization of shamans, throwers, and elemental hazards, Jotunheim has been invaded (or swarmed, rather) by relentless waves of insects. Unlike their colossal neighbors, these bugs can traverse the gorges without the need for magical footbridges.
OBJECTIVES
Oppressive elements and invasive insects melt right down into the objectives awaiting you in Jotunheim as well. From venomous elementals, insect invasions, and newly tough, but not unfair Nithstangs.

We haven't forgotten our signature Curse. This time around centered around the storm that seems to be focusing on the area. Thunderstorms with a chance of strong winds. You might want to leave your umbrellas at home, people.
Check out the Jotunheim video teaser HERE: https://youtu.be/Tm79YOl4buk
What else is dropping with the 0.2 UPDATE?
SKADI - Mistress of ice and precision - joins the Pantheon

Goddess of winter, mountains, and bowhunting (as well as skiing this time of year) is the latest member to our gods roster. With Skadi, the crystal giantess with a particular knack for ice, frost, and everything frozen, we are introducing Seal mechanic - you will be able to lock a skill in place through your level-ups for the moments where you certainly can’t have it both ways. Talk about NOT letting it go with her.

Secondly, with all her skills centered around cold and ice, we have heard your cries and decided to give her the power to blow your problems away a tad more often with additional Banishes and Rerolls.
After all, what’s better than being cool, right?
And to summarize with this - we've been listening closely to your feedback and constantly working to enhance your experience slaying the Hordes of Hel. With that in mind, this update also brings:
A few UI improvements
Hotfixes
Additional language support
Five new trophies to unlock
Stay tuned for more, fierce Jotunnslayers!
Stay strong, keep the momentum and see you in Hel, everyone!

Flammable Wall (Auto-cast): Duration reduced to 2s (from 4s), cooldown improved to 5/4.5/4s (from 9/8/7s).
Flammable Wall Evolve: Damage increased to 36/s (from 27/s), duration reduced to 2s (from 4s), cooldown reduced to 4s (from 6s).
Jotunn’s Blood (Passive): Risk chance reduced to 10% (from 15/20/25%).
Special Delivery (Passive): Trigger distance reduced to 30m (from 40m), risk chance reduced to 10% (from 15%).
Rigged Lottery (Passive): Instant Gold reward increased to 10/20/30 (from 7/10/13).
Goodbye Screen: The "Goodbye Screen" has been removed, and now the Leave Feedback and Join Discord buttons appear directly in the main menu.
Skill Shop Tweaks: Adjusted the Skill Shop interface for a better user experience.
Skill Shop Exclamation Point: Added an exclamation point indicator to highlight that you have enough gold to buy skill points.
Curse of Heat: Reworked the visual effect for a more immersive experience.
SFX Hotfix: Fixed a bug causing double rewards and unintended interactions with circle SFX.
Intro Fadeout: Improved the fadeout effect during the intro for smoother transitions.
Boss Fight Revive Cooldown: Fixed an issue where cooldowns becoming excessively slow after using revive in a boss fight.
Portal Spawning Issue: Fixed an issue where two portals would spawn too close to each other in Insane difficulty.
Menu Interaction During Cutscene: Resolved an issue where interacting with the menu during a cutscene or pop-up caused problems.
Sound Buffering with Unfocused Window: Fixed sound buffering issues when the game window is unfocused.
Trophy Hall Unlock Display: Fixed the issue where unlocked conditions were visible in the Trophy Hall in the demo.
Fire Tornado Persistence: Fire Tornado no longer persists after revive during the Curse of Heat.
Elite Chest Visual Bug: Fixed a visual bug with rare chests spawned by Elite enemies.
Thorns Instant Damage: Resolved an issue where Thorns spawned under the player, causing instant damage.
Crippling Axes Bug: Fixed the issue where Crippling Axes provided 10% instead of the intended 5% effect.
Explosion Area Dash Issue: Fixed the issue where explosion areas moved with the player's dash.
Skill Selection Lock After Alt+Tab: Fixed the issue where the skill selection screen became locked after alt+tabbing during the Temple Screen.
Game Behind Pause Menu After Alt-Tab: Fixed an issue where the game would run behind the "Pause Menu" screen after alt-tabbing.
Result Screen Placeholders: Fixed placeholder text and icons appearing on the result screen.
Mouse Cursor Visibility: Fixed the issue where the mouse cursor was not visible on the game paused screen during cutscenes.
Flame Sister Evasion Bonus: Fixed an issue where the evasion bonus on the Flame Sister was not working.
Level Up Tab Button Hitbox: Corrected the hitbox for the Level Up Tab button.
Skill Reset Stuck Bug: Fixed the issue where players could get stuck in the game when resetting skills while a popup was displayed.
Banished Skill Chest Reward: Banished skills will no longer show up as chest rewards.
Known issues (Work in progress)
Mouse cursor doesn't always disappear when using gamepad
Video settings are being synced over cloud
Game Freezes - game freezes for some players in Easy or Normal Niflheim, though the issue usually resolves after reinstall

items.text: Hey Jotunnslayers! We're bringing you a Hotfix to address a reported issues. We're still working on additional fixes based on your feedback!
Niflheim Archer Arrows: Updated visuals for better visibility.
Evolve Level Requirement: Reduced from level 20 to 18.
XP Drop Rate: Increased by 5% globally.
Text Clarity: Changed ‘Twitch Code’ to ‘Channel Name’ for better clarity (English only).
Chinese Feedback Forms: Traditional and Simplified Chinese feedback forms are now available.
Simplified Chinese Discord Button: The ‘Discord’ button now correctly links to QQ instead.
Audio & VFX: Multiple improvements and fixes applied.
Data Collection Popup: No longer appears every time you enter the main menu.
Skill Points Reset: Skill points no longer disappear when resetting them with a gamepad.
Boss Summoning FPS Drop: Fixed an issue that caused FPS drops when summoning a boss.
Flame Sister Audio Fix: Flame Sister no longer plays Berserker grunts after upgrading base attack range.
Evasion Chance Fix: Now correctly applies to enemy skills (except for boss attacks).
Curse Effects Persist: Some effects from Curse of Heat or Curse of Winter may remain after revival. A fix is in progress.
Video Settings Sync Issue: Video settings are currently being transferred between devices via Steam Cloud. We’re investigating a solution.
Game Freezes: Some players may experience game freezes in Easy or Normal Niflheim. Reinstalling often resolves the issue, but we are working on a permanent fix.
Mouse Cursor Issue: The mouse cursor may not disappear when using a gamepad. A fix is in development.
Alt+Tab Issue: Certain key combinations may cause the game to continue running despite being paused. This will be addressed in an upcoming update.

Coming Soon: We are also working on a rebalancing patch to improve gameplay balance - stay tuned!

items.text: Hotfix 0.1.0.7 - Patch Notes
Hey Jotunnslayers! We're bringing you a Hotfix to address a few reported issues. We're still working on additional fixes based on your feedback!
Nithstangs: Objective choices will now always offer an alternative if Nithstangs are also offered.
Skill Points Reset Bug: Resolved an issue where the skill points reset could be broken.
Framerate spikes on Steam Deck: Fixed framerate issues on Steam Deck during curse of Winter
Controller Options Scroller: Corrected the behavior of the options scroller, which previously followed an erratic pattern.
Soul Shards Spell Unlock: Fixed the issue where the Soul Shards spell was unlocked even if it was not activated in the skill shop.
Screen Distortion: Resolved screen distortion issue when the fire borders effect was played.
Chinese/Japanese/Korean Texts: Fixed an issue where some texts were missing support for CJK languages.
FPS Limiting: The game now properly respects the FPS limit set by the player.
Redirecting Issues: Addressed several redirection issues to improve game flow and navigation.
Ghostwolf Visibility: Fixed an issue where Ghostwolfs would be cut out from some areas inside Nithstangs.
Skeleton Guardian Damage: The Skeleton Guardian now properly damages the player upon contact.
Insane Difficulty - Ranger Weapon Accuracy: Fixed an issue in Insane Difficulty where the Ranger character struggled to hit the frozen objective consistently, making the game unnecessarily difficult.
Nilfheim Spawn Points & Collisions: Improved spawn points and movement collision issues in Nilfheim.
Level Difficulty Reset: The chosen level difficulty no longer resets when exiting the game.
Skin Persistence: The game now properly remembers all selected skins, rather than only the last one.
Weapon Skin Swap: Fixed an issue where the Flame Sister's weapon skins were swapped.
Menu Interaction During Cutscenes: Players can no longer interact with the menu during a cutscene or pop-up.
Dash and Weapon Skill Flashing: Both the dash and weapon skills now properly flash when available.
Texture Quality Adjustments: Fixed an issue where lowering texture quality also unintentionally lowered the HUD texture quality.
Demo Issues - Berserkers' Weapon Text: Fixed the issue where the Berserkers' weapon Swift Axes text was visible during the demo.
Demo Issues - Trophy Hall: Removed the visible unlocked condition in the Trophy Hall during the demo.
Chain Stretching: Fixed an issue where chains were stretching and not properly attached to objects.
Error Logs Overload: Significantly reduced the number of unnecessary error logs that were appearing in the game.

releases.displayName: UPDATE ON DEMO (and a few more cool things!)

items.text: Hey Survivors!
We have some news for you all!
DEMO DATES

First, we would like to update you on the demo release. Recently, we`ve gathered feedback on the current build from our game dev colleagues, industry partners, and peers from other studios. Some of the ideas we received so far add significant value and make a difference, so we've decided to work a bit longer on the game before delivering the demo into your hands. But there is no reason to worry. Although it has been postponed a bit due to the above-mentioned reasons, the demo is coming out SOON!
We will come back to you soon with more updates as we progress with the game’s polishing.
But for the most impatient ones, we are preparing to arrange an…
OPEN CALL FOR EXCLUSIVE BETA TESTING

The juicy part of today's announcement is that before the demo release, we will open a call for a small and intimate closed beta for a limited number of players. These players will be granted an exclusive chance to explore the game, fight hordes of twisted enemies, and share their first impressions and ideas with us!
Dates and details will be announced next week.
And there's more…
DEVLOGS

To keep you closer to the team and the game itself, and to show you more about its inspiration and current progress, we’ll introduce regular devlogs. These will cover a wide variety of themes straight from the Dark Viking Underworld, including its Gods, enemies, gameplay, maps, and more.

Finally, we must say that we are stoked to share our progress with you regularly and look forward to hearing your feedback on every step of this (hopefully epic) journey! Your input is invaluable to us, and rest assured that we will listen to it carefully.
See you on Discord!
Cheers!
